about.title: About Us
about.desc: The Palestine Math Olympiad is a national initiative dedicated to discovering, training, and empowering talented students in mathematics. Through a series of competitive stages, engaging workshops, and collaborative partnerships, we aim to strengthen mathematical excellence and inspire the next generation of problem-solvers and innovators across Palestine.

prep.title: Preparation Stage
prep.desc: Students join trainings and practice problems to build strong math skills before the competition starts.

rounds.title: Preliminary Rounds
rounds.desc: Participants take qualifying exams to select the top students for the advanced stages.

finals.title: Finals
finals.desc: Top students compete in the final round with challenging problems testing logic and creativity.

awards.title: Awards & Recognition
awards.desc: Winners receive medals, certificates, and public recognition for their achievements.

finish.title: Finish Stage
finish.desc: The competition concludes, results are published, and preparations begin for the next Olympiad.
